title: Step 5 - Hierarchical Clustering in R: Understanding Customer Spending Patterns

cues.en: And here is our hierarchical clustering results obtained in our.
cues.zh: 這就是在 R 中得到的階層式分群結果。

cues.en: So let's have a closer look at these Custers and understand what they are.
cues.zh: 仔細看這些群組，了解它們是什麼。

cues.en: Our first cluster is close to one which is the blue cluster right here and it contains the customers that have high income and high spending score.
cues.zh: 第一個是第一群，也就是這裡的藍色群組，包含收入高、消費分數也高的顧客。

cues.en: So that's an interesting cluster for them all because customers in this cluster have a high income and spend a lot of money in the mall.
cues.zh: 對購物中心來說很值得關注，因為這群顧客收入高，而且在購物中心花很多錢。

cues.en: So this cluster would be a good target of the mall marketing campaigns.
cues.zh: 所以這群會是購物中心行銷活動的好目標。

cues.en: And so we can call this cluster the target one.
cues.zh: 可以稱為「目標客群」。

cues.en: OK now cluster to constitute contains the customers that have high income and low spending score.
cues.zh: 第二群包含收入高、消費分數低的顧客。

cues.en: And so we can call these customers to careful customers.
cues.zh: 可以稱為「謹慎型」顧客。

cues.en: Now cluster three customers in this cluster have average income and average spending score.
cues.zh: 第三群，這些顧客收入中等，消費分數也中等。

cues.en: So we call this cluster standard cluster.
cues.zh: 稱為「一般型」群組。

cues.en: Now cluster forecaster for the customers that have low income and low spending score.
cues.zh: 第四群，是收入低、消費分數也低的顧客。

cues.en: So that's basically sensable customers who pay attention to the money they spend.
cues.zh: 基本上是理性的顧客，會留意自己花多少錢，

cues.en: By paying attention to the money they earn and eventually close to 5 contains the customers that have low income but high spending score.
cues.zh: 也會考慮賺多少錢。最後第五群，包含收入低，消費分數卻高的顧客。

cues.en: So these are customers who are rather careless especially the 119 and customer here who earns a low income but spends a lot of money.
cues.zh: 這些顧客比較隨性，尤其這位編號 119 的顧客，收入低，卻花很多錢。

cues.en: So this one should particularly be careful.
cues.zh: 這位特別應該小心。

cues.en: And actually this cluster five here could be a very interesting cluster for the market.
cues.zh: 其實第五群對購物中心來說也很值得關注，

cues.en: If the latter has a social responsibility as it is the case for more and more companies today.
cues.zh: 如果它具有社會責任感的話，正如現在越來越多企業那樣。

cues.en: All right so we are done with hierarchical clustering in our if you want to reuse this code for your business problem it's very easy you just have to change the name of the data set here then change the
cues.zh: 好，R 中的階層式分群完成了。如果想把程式碼用在自己的商業問題，很簡單，只需要更改這裡的資料集名稱，再更改

cues.en: indexes of your columns of interest just below.
cues.zh: 下方感興趣欄位的索引。

cues.en: However if you do clustering in more than two dimensions don't execute the last section visualizing the clusters because it's only for two dimensions but don't delete the section and leave it as comments
cues.zh: 不過，如果分群超過二維，就不要執行最後「群組視覺化」區段，因為它只適用二維；但不要刪掉，保留為註解，

cues.en: because later in this course we will learn a super powerful technique called dimensionality reduction that will reduce the dimensions of your data to perhaps two dimensions so that you can use this final
cues.zh: 因為本課稍後會學一個非常強大的技術，叫做降維，可以把資料維度降到例如二維，這樣就能使用最後的

cues.en: section visualizing the clusters to see your clusters in two dimensions.
cues.zh: 「群組視覺化」區段，在二維中查看群組。

cues.en: All right so that's the end of hierarchical clustering in our.
cues.zh: 好，R 中的階層式分群到此結束。

cues.en: And that's also the end of hierarchical clustering and then the next section we will recap everything we've learned in clustering.
cues.zh: 這也是階層式分群的結尾，下一個單元會回顧在分群中學到的所有內容。

cues.zh: 謝謝觀看這堂課。

cues.zh: 希望你現在更熟悉如何用 R 或 Python 做分群。

cues.zh: 期待接下來的課再見。

cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你分群愉快。
